Lucky 9 — Filipino Hybrid (Rotating Banker)

Card values: A=1, 2–9 face value, 10/J/Q/K=0. Hand value is the sum modulo 10. Max 3 cards per hand.

Round flow: Betting (5s) → Pre-deal pause (2s) → Deal 2 cards → auto-reveal Natural 9 if any → Hit/Stand (5s/player) → Banker plays → Reveal (1s/player; banker last) → Settlement.

Natural 9 = first two cards summing to 9. Player N9 auto-stands and cannot lose. Banker N9 wins all (except ties vs Natural 9). Both N9 = tie + both get a win bar. Natural 9 vs 3-card 9 = tie + both get a win bar.

Win/Loss: Player beats banker = 1:1; Player Natural 9 beats banker = 1.5:1; Banker beats player = banker takes player\'s bet; Tie = no money changes hands.

Win Bars: 5 segments. Win or tie = +1 bar (both parties on tie). First to 5 wins the jackpot. Multi-winner same round = split equally.

Jackpot: every non-banker pays the table ante each round into the pool. Resets when paid.

Tier rules: Reserve = 90% of tier minimum. Min bet = 3% of tier minimum. Ante = 50% of min bet. Max bet = (banker wallet − reserve) ÷ non-banker count.

Banker rotation: Clockwise each round. Banker is skipped if (wallet − reserve) ÷ players < min bet.

Wallet safeguards: Entry requires wallet ≥ tier minimum. No all-in: bet capped to keep wallet ≥ tier minimum. Lockout if wallet drops below 20% of tier minimum.

Currency: Virtual play money only. Deposit/withdraw are simulated database operations for academic demonstration.

1. Choose your table
Pick a tier you can afford (your wallet must be ≥ the tier minimum).

2. Place your bet
Each round you have 5 seconds to bet. The minimum is 3%% of the tier value. The max depends on how much the banker can cover.

3. Hit or Stand
You get 2 cards face-down. If they total 9 (Natural 9), you auto-stand. Otherwise, choose HIT for a third card (max 3 cards) or STAND.

4. Banker reveals last
Cards flip in order. Compare your hand vs the banker. Modulo 10 — only the last digit counts.

5. Race to 5
Win or tie = +1 win bar. Reach 5 first and you win the jackpot. Then the bars reset.

6. Banker rotates
The crown moves clockwise each round.
